confirmed_matches.uberon_definition: A belly of the occipitofrontalis muscle that is near the frontal bone.
confirmed_matches.wikipedia_summary: The frontalis muscle (frontal belly of the occipitofrontalis) is a muscle that covers parts of the forehead; it has no bony attachments and inserts into the epicranial aponeurosis. It is innervated by the temporal branches of the facial nerve and raises the eyebrows.
